decision.title: JavaScript bindings for XQuery, XSLT and XSD validation (packet )
decision.summary: The JavaScript package's full module links shim files for XQuery, XSLT and XSD validation, with compile-once APIs compileQuery, compileStylesheet and compileSchema, while sxml.wasm stays unchanged.

body.p: , after , , , , , , . The package (bindings/javascript) covered XPath only.

item.p: Mechanism: 's two links. The full module links four more shim files (sxml_javascript_full.c, _xquery.c, _xslt.c, _schema.c); the core module links none, so sxml.wasm is byte for byte what it was. The package tells the modules apart by the exports (sxml_javascript_query_compile present or not), not by a feature: XQuery, XSLT and XSD are whole front ends, not optional features of a processor. The handles and helpers both links share moved to sxml_javascript_internal.h, still static (an inline hint on all of them made the core 1,609 bytes larger).

API (src/index.ts), in the XPath style, compile once, run many times: Processor.compileQuery(text, { namespaces, baseUri }) gives an XQuery (evaluate({ context, variables, updates, messages }) to a Value, serialize(value) with the prolog's output declarations, run() both, isUpdating); Processor.compileStylesheet(text, { baseUri, staticParameters }) gives a Stylesheet (transform({ source, initialMatchSelection, initialMode, initialTemplate, initialFunction, args, parameters, templateParameters, tunnelParameters, baseOutputUri, delivery, resultDocumentDelivery, serialization, messages }) to { output, value, resultDocuments }); Processor.compileSchema(documents, { baseUri }) gives a Schema (validate(text or node, { mode, type, uri }) to { validity, reports, document }). Errors are SxmlError (now with sourceName); a schema that does not compile throws SchemaError with every report. Library modules, included modules, packages and schema documents come through the resolver.

Side results (glossary ): what a call delivers besides its result (updated trees and fn:put documents of the update sink, result documents from the built-in collector, trace output, schema reports) is kept by the handle until its next call and written into the request; the package adopts every value at once, then hands them to the updates sink and messages callback after the call, also when it failed. No host import is added: callbacks never run inside sxml.

Defaults taken (): invalid input is a result, not an exception; a transformation without source and initialMatchSelection calls xsl:initial-template, as sxml transform does; replaces the unnamed xsl:output's parameters, method included (the parameter reader cannot merge); fn:put without putDocument raises FOUP0002 (xquery.h); text is validated in one pass by the XML parser without external entities (the null entity resolver), so reports have lines and columns, a node by copy (sxml_schema_validate_node's steps, keeping the validator for the not-known outcome that function does not give); xsl:message as the text method writes it, fn:trace and fn:message by the adaptive method.

Sizes (stripped / gzip -9): sxml.wasm 2,134,058 / 730,518 unchanged; sxml-full.wasm 3,666,545 / 1,124,343 to 6,570,723 / 1,328,474, almost all the XQuery compiler and its grammar. The full budget rises to 7,000,000 / 2,450,000 (; 's ratio of 0.35).

Tests: test/full.test.ts, 24 tests under Node 22, as javascript/languages_full; javascript/languages runs it on the core module, where it checks that the three are refused. The existing package tests pass on both modules.
